description: This file defines an Angular service class 'JsLibraryTableConfigResolver' that configures and manages a resource table for JavaScript libraries/resources within an admin UI, including actions like open, download, delete, and handling resource data fetching and permissions.

classes.name: JsLibraryTableConfigResolver
classes.description: An Angular service that provides configuration for a resource table displaying JavaScript libraries, including data fetching, actions, permissions, and UI interactions.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Initializes and returns the table configuration, setting title, permissions, and data fetch functions.

methods.name: openResource
methods.description: Opens a specific resource in the UI based on its ID.

methods.name: downloadResource
methods.description: Triggers download of a specified resource.

methods.name: onResourceAction
methods.description: Handles actions triggered on resources such as open, download, or delete.

methods.name: detailsReadonly
methods.description: Determines if resource details are readonly based on permissions.

methods.name: isResourceEditable
methods.description: Checks if a resource is editable based on user authority.

methods.name: deleteResource
methods.description: Handles deletion of a single resource, including confirmation and error handling.

methods.name: deleteResources
methods.description: Handles bulk deletion of resources with confirmation and error handling.

methods.name: configureCellActions
methods.description: Configures context menu actions for resource table cells, such as download and delete.
